title: Nested include! slice C, formatting only: rustfmt the persist fragment files before 16 of them become modules
outcome: Slice C of w-05336c2d00a3 converts 16 of the 19 fragments that src/persist.rs includes into child modules of persist.rs, with scripts/include-to-mod.mjs (a sibling item). `cargo fmt` does not reach an included file; 6 of the 19 files that conversion brings within its reach (the 16 fragments and three module files they declare) are not what rustfmt prints: src/persist_boot_timings.rs, src/persist_sqlite_maintenance_tests.rs, src/persist_sqlite_obligations_tests.rs, src/persist_sqlite_reader_floor_tests.rs, src/persist_sqlite_schema.rs and the declared module src/tests/native_test_completion_reader_floor.rs. This candidate formats those files with rustfmt alone and changes nothing else, so that the conversion that follows is only the tool's output. The 16 units are listed in a note on this item. Not in this slice: persist_direct_prompt.rs, persist_metadata_tracking.rs and persist_metadata_units_codec.rs (refused by the tool; coordinator's rulings in TermAl mailbox 30a7a691 #149).
acceptance: This item's contribution to the candidate commit changes only files under src that slice C's conversion brings within `cargo fmt`'s reach: the fragment files of the listed units and the module files those fragments declare; every other path the commit changes belongs to another item, whose contribution is recorded with it.

For every path of this item's contribution, `git show PARENT:path | rustfmt --edition 2024` prints exactly the candidate's content of that path, where PARENT is the candidate's parent commit; the rustfmt version is recorded with the check.

The set of test names printed by `cargo test --bin termal -- --list` is the same on the candidate as on the candidate without this item's contribution, on one host; for a candidate that holds only this item's contribution that is its parent.
No test reads or pins source text for this change.
